purpose: Test partial-source exposure separately from additional training, normalization changes, distillation and rule expansion.

evidence.interpretation: The frozen learner's response to deleting sources is not an information-theoretic lower bound; prior training did not explicitly expose partial source sets.

initialization.wait_for: Completed current architecture queue and paired validation evaluation
initialization.architecture: Lower three-seed mean Val macro RMSE among baseline and the queue-selected candidate; exact tie favors baseline
initialization.checkpoint: Always the selected architecture's seed 20260905 best checkpoint, never its best-performing seed

training.sampling_d4_loss_gradient_clip_ema_amp_b: Same as original trainer, shared seed and sample/D4 schedule between arms
training.mixed_schedule: Independent reproducible permutation with exactly 1500 full9 and 1500 greedy3 batches; repeated AMP attempts reuse the same action
training.partial_input_layout: Actual variable-length K=3 encoding, not nine-slot zero padding
training.full_control_schedule: Same recorded source schedule but always supplies full9
training.greedy3_indices: Frozen ../fit_subsets.json; all source indices chosen without target temperature

validation.best_pt: Minimum arithmetic mean of full9 and greedy3 macro RMSE at the same step and weights; earlier candidate wins exact tie
validation.best_full9_pt: Minimum full9 macro RMSE from the same 26 weight candidates, retained as an additional strong fixed comparator
validation.best_greedy3_pt: Minimum greedy3 macro RMSE from the same 26 weight candidates, retained to prevent a weaker fixed-three-source comparator

usage_evaluation.primary_rule: Existing cover_greedy_0: choose greedy3 if it loses none of the nine-source reliable coverage; otherwise full9
usage_evaluation.strong_fixed_comparators: Both arms' joint-selected, full9-selected and greedy3-selected checkpoints, plus the frozen initialization and final stronger-network full9; compare common scenes/support and include any stronger fixed strategy
usage_evaluation.other_existing_rules: May be reported under their existing Fit/Val selection protocol, separately from the single primary rule; no new threshold grid
usage_evaluation.first_screen: Fit/Val only; no Test merely because adaptation training completed
usage_evaluation.replication: Repeat the matched adaptation pair only if first-seed necessary gates pass; confirm across cities before any separate frozen consumed-Test30 evaluation
usage_evaluation.source_saving_scope: Historical encoder tokens, not reduced download or input availability
usage_evaluation.goal_one_independent: This adaptation cannot substitute for the separately required reproducible network improvement over U-TAE.
